content.help: Enables shadows from moving clouds outdoors.
Controls how strongly clouds dim direct sunlight.

When enabled, each weather below uses its own shadow opacity, fading gradually as the weather changes. A weather you have not changed, and DLC or mod weathers, use Shadow opacity. F4SE Menu Framework also lists DLC and mod weathers. Off by default.
Shadow opacity during clear weather (Fallout4.esm 02B52A). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during clearest skies weather (Fallout4.esm 1D670E). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during overcast weather (Fallout4.esm 1C8556). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during foggy weather (Fallout4.esm 1C3473). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during misty weather (Fallout4.esm 1CC186). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during misty rain weather (Fallout4.esm 1CD096). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during rain weather (Fallout4.esm 1CA7E4). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during radstorm weather (Fallout4.esm 1C3D5E). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during Glowing Sea overcast weather (Fallout4.esm 0F1033). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during marsh overcast weather (Fallout4.esm 10F781). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during Goodneighbor weather (Fallout4.esm 115C64). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.
Shadow opacity during Sanctuary (pre-war) weather (Fallout4.esm 12A18E). Until you move this slider, the weather uses Shadow opacity.

When enabled, close MCM and use:
F11 - Open/close the development menu and start an FPS test.
F10 - Toggle cloud shadows for a manual FPS comparison.
The menu shows ON/OFF averages and can run an automatic comparison. Stand still outdoors. Desktop only. Off by default.
